name: Founder Technology Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Founder Technology Group Co.,Ltd. focuses on the design, research, manufacturing, and sale of printed circuit boards (PCB) in China. The company offers high-multilayer boards, HDI boards, rigid-flex boards, and customized PCBs. Its products are used in communication equipment, smart terminals, switches, optical modules, AI servers, and special applications. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
